description: An interface for execution details of tasks that support asynchronous execution by a sub-worker. The concreteType determines which sub-worker handles execution.

asyncJobId.description: The ID of the async job currently executing this task. Set when execution starts; cleared on completion or failure.

startedBy.description: The principal ID of the user who started the execution.

errorMessage.description: If execution failed, the error description.

errorDetails.description: If execution failed, additional error details.
